title: The "Zero-Click" Operatory
summary: Explore how ambient AI generates clinical notes and voice perio charts in real time, removing keyboards from the operatory and eliminating after-hours charting.
body_markdown:
What if the clinical note wrote itself while you cared for your patient? This complimentary **CE course** explores a new generation of hands-free documentation that takes the keyboard out of the operatory.


With ambient AI, providers simply talk with and examine their patients while accurate, structured notes are generated in the background and flow directly into the clinical record — no dictation, no typing, no end-of-day catch-up.


On the hygiene side, AI-driven voice perio charting captures pocket depths, bleeding, and recession by voice alone. Think gloves-on, no second person required, and with multilingual support.


Webinar, attendees will learn how ambient documentation and voice charting differ, where each fits in clinical workflows, and how a "zero-click" approach strengthens patient education, treatment acceptance, and the completeness and defensibility of the clinical record.


**Learning Objectives:**


1. Differentiate between ambient AI documentation and voice-command charting technologies and identify the clinical workflows each is designed to support.
2. Evaluate AI documentation tools against key criteria including note accuracy, perio data integrity, HIPAA compliance, and record defensibility.
3. Develop an implementation plan for introducing hands-free documentation into hygiene and restorative workflows with minimal disruption.
